result:
Round 237 failed C, so the next task is round 238, a fix-up on round 237's code. Decision: **CONTINUE** (D-29z346…D-29z351).

**Round 237 result**
- C passed 15 rows with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true. The three planned bugs are fixed in the real browser.
- C found one Medium regression this round caused, **C-R237-01**. If a "not while dragging" refusal is on screen when loading finishes, letting go of the mouse brings back the old text `Loading the demo collection…`, and it stays.
- Gate 237 was skipped, so nothing was published. HEAD is still `ecaf0e4`, and that is the baseline. Round 237's 11 changed files are kept, and their hashes are recorded.
- In the backlog nothing closes. The round-237 fixes close only when round 238 passes and the gate publishes both rounds together.

**Round 238 (`current-task.md`)**
- **C-R237-01:** A's proposed fix is accepted. When loading finishes, the remembered "last non-refusal" text is recalculated with the same rule round 237 introduced.
- **A-R237-REVIEW-L1** (Low): fixed now rather than deferred. I reproduced it through the code's own functions, not through the UI: a tempo message added onto a refusal stayed on screen after letting go. I found no way to reach it from the UI. It is fixed now because it is the same small function, which this round already owns. The rule recognises a refusal even when text follows it, and on release removes only the refusal part.
- **Scope:** three files may change: `ArrangementContext.tsx`, `tempo-seed-ui.test.tsx` (new tests TU12–TU15, added at the end only) and doc 185 (status line set to round 238). 1,098 files are frozen, including every protected auth and purchase file. `/studio-lab` stays demo-only and anonymous.
- **My pre-check on a scratch copy:**
  - 121 test files with 1,719 tests all passed.
  - Removing each part of the fix makes the matching new test fail (TU12/TU13 for the first bug, TU15 for the second).
  - C's own reproduction script now ends on the ready text at both viewports.
- **C's checks:**
  - the refusal reproduction, plus a variant where one file fails to load and a case with no loading involved;
  - round 237's four status checks again;
  - the unit tests and the test-breaking checks;
  - doc 185;
  - the anonymous `/studio-lab` and sign-in checks, and a smoke run with a WAV export.
  - The purchased-collection browser check stays BLOCKED, because there is no backend in the cloud.

**Other updates**
- I archived the round-237 task as `tasks/round-237.md`. I updated the backlog (to version 223), `feature-status.md`, the B report `b-round-237.md` and `b-next.json`.
- A third addendum went to the open architecture checkpoint request. It records the reviewer's suggestion of structured status parts as a signal, not a scheduled task. It is still non-blocking, and should run before SABA-B-11b.
- This miss was not one Saba reported, so I did not edit `lessons.md`. It is recorded for RETRO 245 instead.
- The regression round is due from 2026-10-30, so the next planning will probably be the regression round, then SABA-B-11b.
- The advisor was available, and I consulted it twice: before writing and before handover. I followed its corrections.
- No file in `store/` changed. The scratch copy and its test server were outside the repo, and the server was stopped.
